The Penalty Box Experience

More Than Just Game-Day Food.

Hockey nights run on more than goals. They run on the smell of fries drifting down the concourse, the roar when the home team scores, and a tray of something hot and loaded in your hands when it happens. Penalty Box is built for exactly that — the stand where fans refuel, regroup and get back to their seats before the puck drops again.

Everything is made to order, served fast, and priced for real fans. Whether it is your kid's first game or your five-hundredth, this is your spot between periods.

01

Made Fresh, Served Fast

Short lines and a tight menu mean you are back in your seat before the intermission ends.

02

Built for the Whole Bench

Combos and shareable trays sized for families, teammates and entire rows of fans.

03

Rink-Side, Always

Steps from the ice, inside the arena — no leaving the game to find something worth eating.
